name: subcurrent-backend
description: Subcurrent API — fans, tickets, teams/owner portal. SQLite by default; swap to Postgres by changing DATABASE_URL.

scripts.pretest: rm -f test.db prisma/test.db prisma/test.db-journal && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node scripts/prisma.js db push
scripts.db:setup: node scripts/prisma.js db push && node prisma/seed.js
scripts.test:pg: DATABASE_URL=${TEST_PG_URL:-postgresql://$USER@localhost:5432/subcurrent_test} sh -c 'node scripts/prisma.js generate && node scripts/prisma.js db push --force-reset --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && vitest run'
